properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in North

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Northeast Cape Fear River near Burgaw.

* WHEN...From Friday evening to Tuesday morning.

* IMPACTS...At 12.0 feet, Flooding worsens in the River Bend, River
Birch and Alligator Lake subdivisions. Flooding on Croomsbridge RD
and Old Maple Hill RD worsens and the roads may be impassable in
multiple locations.  Holly Shelter Estates begins to flood and
flooding in Sandy Bend worsens.  Flooding worsens near the ends of
Turtle Hill TR, Hickory Hill LN, White Tail LN, Mallard Roost DR,
and Oxbow Landing.  Shaw Hwy is flooded at Ashes and Lillington
Creeks. Equine Landing RD area may flood.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:30 PM EST Thursday the stage was 5.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage
tomorrow evening to a crest of 11.8 feet Saturday evening. It
will then fall below flood stage Monday afternoon.
- Flood stage is 10.0 feet.
- weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:

properties.title: Flood Warning issued November 26 at 8:58PM EST by NWS Melbourne FL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida...

St Johns River Near Astor affecting Volusia and Lake Counties.

.Heavy rainfall working its way through the basin will cause levels
on the St Johns River at Astor to remain steady within Major Flood
Stage between 4.3 and 4.4 feet.

For the St. Johns River...including Astor...Major flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Major flooding is occurring and major flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...St Johns River near Astor.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 4.5 feet, Major widespread and long duration flooding
occurs, with water rescues and evacuations necessary. Most
low-lying homes become uninhabitable due to 2 to 3 feet water depth
in many areas of the community on or near the river. Water reaches
Front Street south of SR-40. Areas off of Riveredge Drive are
inaccessible. Water surrounds and enters homes on Riverview Drive
and Claire Street. Most areas near the Astor Landing Campground are
inaccessible due to knee-deep water.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:30 PM EST Thursday the stage was 4.4 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 2.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 8:30 PM EST Thursday was 4.4 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to remain generally steady
between 4.3 and 4.4 feet through early next week.
- Flood stage is 2.3 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
